g.text: at most k = 2 pieces can be damaged
piece 3 is an EXACT substring of the target term
the pigeonhole principle forces at least one piece to escape every edit — an exact
substring seed for the dictionary search. Transposition and Merge/Split need
pieces: one boundary-spanning edit can corrupt two adjacent pieces at
once, so k such edits may dirty up to 2k pieces. (Counts are Coq-verified upstream.)
